name: Golden A/S Service
subtitle: Field service for Golden staff
promotionalText: The field tool of Golden A/S service engineers — reports, tickets, equipment and hours, on board and offline.
description:
Golden A/S Service is the field application for the service engineers of Golden Automation Systems (Golden A/S), the marine electrical, automation and navigation systems integrator based in Keratsini, Greece, with branches in Italy and the Netherlands.

An account issued by Golden A/S is required. The app is a companion to the Golden A/S portal and is not intended for the general public.

With it an engineer on board or at a shipyard can:
• see the tickets and work orders assigned to them and the day's schedule
• write field service and inspection reports with tasks, time lines, parts and photos taken with the camera, and submit them for approval
• browse the equipment of the vessel by system or location, with its service history
• book working hours per project and section, with overtime, holiday and travel
• reach HR for leave requests and messages
• keep working without a connection — drafts are kept on the device and synchronised later

Sign-in with password and authenticator code, or with Face ID / Touch ID and passkeys after the first sign-in. All data stays on the Golden A/S portal; nothing is shared with third parties.
whatsNew: First App Store release of the Golden A/S Service app: field and inspection reports, tickets, equipment, hours, HR requests, offline drafts, passkeys.
reviewNotes:
This is the field application for employees of Golden Automation Systems (Golden A/S); it is distributed unlisted to our staff and requires an account issued by the company.

Please sign in with the demo account provided (a staff user with a demo project; no real customer data). No authenticator code is needed for this account. After sign-in: Home shows the assigned tickets; Reports › + Field Service Report shows the report form with camera upload; Equipment lists a vessel's systems; Hours books time. Push notifications and passkeys are optional.
